# ISF effects — credits

Vendored from the Vidvox ISF-Files collection, MIT at the repository root,
on 2026-11-08. Nothing is fetched at runtime.

The root MIT licence cannot grant rights the project never held, so the
seven shaders the licensing audit flagged — Boxinator (CC BY-NC-SA), Brick
Pattern and Video Bricks (Book of Shaders, all rights reserved), ASCII Art
and Smoke Screen (Shadertoy, unstated), Frosted Glass (Geeks3D, unstated)
and Truchet Tile (upstream gone) — are excluded by name and are not here.
